rules.prepare:
# What buildconf.sh does. The script itself asks for bash, which is not # there when expat is built for the first time. (cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/expat" && autoreconf --warnings=all --install --verbose)
mkdir -p "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/expat"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/expat" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/expat/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/expat" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/aclocal" install -m 0644 "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/expat/conftools/expat.m4" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/aclocal"
